name: optaeo/module-aeo
description: OptAEO — Agentic Engine Optimisation for Magento, Adobe Commerce and Mage-OS. Emits one authoritative schema.org Product JSON-LD node (with native-microdata suppression on Luma), serves catalogue-aware llms.txt + agents.txt at the store root, provisions the GTIN and descriptive product attributes, and exposes review-summary + shipping-config read APIs for AI shopping agents.
